newsitem.title: EGYPT: Three killed trying to save boy from Cairo sewers.
newsitem.headline: Three killed trying to save boy from Cairo sewers.

text.p: Three Egyptian men died in the Cairo sewers trying to rescue a six-year-old boy who fell down an open manhole, the government newspaper al-Akhbar said on Sunday. The boy is missing assumed dead.
The accident took place on Saturday afternoon in the north Cairo suburb of Shubra, it said. Two men who joined the rescue attempt were pulled back to the surface with ropes.
It was the latest in a series of accidents with manholes left uncovered during repairs or cleaning work. Most of the victims have been young children.
